mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.tenant_invitations (id, tenant_key, invited_email, invited_by, authority, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by) VALUES (#{id}, #{tenantKey}, #{invitedEmail}, #{invitedBy}, #{authority}, #{token}, #{status, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{expiresAt}, #{acceptedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt}, #{createdBy}, #{updatedBy})
mapper.select: SELECT id, tenant_key, invited_email, invited_by, authority, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.tenant_invitations WHERE token = #{token} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, invited_email, invited_by, authority, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.tenant_invitations WHERE id = #{id} LIMIT 1

SELECT id, tenant_key, invited_email, invited_by, authority, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.tenant_invitations WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} AND status = 'PENDING' ORDER BY created_at DESC

SELECT id, tenant_key, invited_email, invited_by, authority, token, status, expires_at, accepted_at, created_at, updated_at, created_by, updated_by FROM public.tenant_invitations WHERE tenant_key = #{tenantKey} ORDER BY created_at DESC
